title: Farm Jersey
subtitle: Government and rural economy
summary: A digital home for Jersey's rural economy, pairing a content-rich Webflow site with a purpose-built online portal for Rural Support Scheme grant applications.

sections.label: The brief
sections.body: Farm Jersey supports the island's farmers and fishers, so the site had to do far more than tell a story. Islanders needed one place to find business support, funding routes, events and resources, and the annual Rural Support Scheme needed to move from paperwork to a modern online application process.

sections.caption: Farm Jersey — Webflow site + custom grant portal.

sections.label: What we built
sections.body: The public site leads with three clear journeys: apply for the RSS, get business support, and learn through the Knowledge Hub. Alongside it sits a custom-built portal where applicants complete their agricultural return, land declaration and supporting documents, track progress in real time, and the Farm Jersey team manages every application from an admin dashboard.

sections.label: Highlights
sections.body: Custom Rural Support Scheme portal with application tracking and an admin dashboard • Knowledge Hub resource library, industry events and producer showcases • Warm, photographic design that reflects the island's landscape and community

title: The Mortgage Shop
subtitle: Financial services
client: The Mortgage Shop (Henley Offshore Financial Services)
summary: A confident rebrand online for Jersey's independent mortgage broker, matching over thirty years of expertise with a site that says 'Register Once. Apply everywhere.'

sections.label: The brief
sections.body: The Mortgage Shop has matched Jersey home hunters with lenders since 1990, but needed a site that felt as approachable as its advisers, guided each type of buyer to the right service, and let people act there and then.

sections.label: What we built
sections.body: A bold, characterful design built around clear buyer journeys for first-time buyers, remortgaging, buy to let and moving house. An interactive mortgage calculator estimates monthly repayments, legal fees and stamp duty with first-time buyer logic built in, and appointment booking sits one click away throughout.

sections.label: Highlights
sections.body: Custom mortgage calculator covering repayments, legal fees and stamp duty • Distinctive 3D character illustrations and a strong green identity • Client testimonials, rate newsletter sign-up and appointment booking throughout

quote.text: “A massive thank you for delivering this project early, and on-budget.”
quote.author: Mortgage Shop

title: Virdaris
subtitle: Private wealth and family office
summary: A quietly luxurious site for a Jersey multi family office serving UHNW families, where restraint, typography and motion do the talking.

sections.label: The brief
sections.body: Virdaris offers discreet, best in class family office and fiduciary services to a small number of significant wealth holders. The site had to feel as considered and exclusive as the service itself, building trust without ever shouting.

sections.label: What we built
sections.body: An editorial design built on elegant serif typography, a calm natural palette and slow, layered scroll animations. The structure is deliberately simple: the story of the firm, the founder, two clear service pillars and a Perspectives section for thought leadership, all underpinned by client testimonials.

sections.label: Highlights
sections.body: Refined scroll-driven typography and landscape imagery that set a tone of quiet authority • Perspectives CMS for family office thought leadership • Clear presentation of regulated status and service structure for a discerning audience

quote.text: “I can’t thank or endorse you enough for the amazing process throughout (you can print that!)”
quote.author: Virdaris

title: Chapter 2
subtitle: Talent and recruitment (RPO)
summary: A global-scale site for the AI-enabled talent company positioning itself as the next generation of RPO, complete with a spinning 3D globe and results that speak for themselves.

sections.label: The brief
sections.body: Chapter 2 blends embedded talent teams with its own AI technology and needed a site that could carry that story to global enterprise clients, showcase measurable results and keep pace with a fast-growing team, event calendar and case study library.

sections.label: What we built
sections.body: A crisp, editorial design fronted by an animated 3D globe and bold typography. Four service pillars are laid out in an interactive carousel, client outcomes are given headline treatment, and CMS collections power case studies, events, and a large leadership and advisory team that the Chapter 2 team can update themselves.

sections.label: Highlights
sections.body: Headline client results: offers accepted up 22 percent, cost per hire down 72 percent, 2m dollars of agency spend removed • Animated globe hero and staggered text reveals that bring the brand to life • CMS-driven case studies, events and team profiles built for a growing business

title: Policy Futures
subtitle: Public policy and education
summary: A friendly, accessible campaign site opening up a new route into policy research careers, hosted by three of the UK's leading think tanks.

sections.label: The brief
sections.body: The Policy Futures Programme exists to make policy research careers accessible to people from all backgrounds, so the site had to feel welcoming rather than institutional, answer applicants' questions quickly and drive applications for each annual cohort.

sections.label: What we built
sections.body: A warm, plain-speaking design that puts the essentials up front: what the programme is, who it is for, what it pays and when applications open. Numbered explainer cards, key stats and a cohort testimonial guide would-be applicants from curiosity to application without jargon.

sections.label: Highlights
sections.body: Clear applicant journey: programme, eligibility and how to apply in three steps • Key facts given visual weight: 30k salary, one-year paid programme, three host think tanks • Approachable identity that deliberately avoids the usual think tank formality

title: Foxdocs
subtitle: SaaS and compliance technology
summary: A sharp, product-led marketing site for an AI compliance platform that keeps business policies up to date when regulations change.

sections.label: The brief
sections.body: Foxdocs is a new product in a serious category. The site needed to explain a novel idea quickly, look credible to compliance-minded buyers, and show the real product rather than abstract promises.

sections.label: What we built
sections.body: A dark, confident design with the product itself as the hero: real interface captures sit inside browser frames as the page walks through data sources, AI reviews and staff acknowledgement. Two clear calls to action, analyse a document and book a demo, run throughout.

sections.label: Highlights
sections.body: Product-first storytelling with genuine app UI throughout • Feature narrative covering AI reviews, integrations and regulator expectations • Striking dark identity with a distinctive green accent

title: Steedman Planning
subtitle: Planning and design consultancy
summary: A calm, portfolio-led site for a Jersey planning consultancy whose work shapes the island's places, from affordable homes to agri-solar infrastructure.

sections.label: The brief
sections.body: Steedman Planning needed its projects to do the persuading: a small consultancy with an outsized portfolio, from 200 affordable homes to National Park golf course realignment, and a people-first ethos that had to come through.

sections.label: What we built
sections.body: A clean, earthy design centred on a featured projects carousel, with services grouped into planning and design, environment and community. Client testimonials from the likes of Jersey Electricity and La Moye Golf Club anchor the consultancy's credibility, and the team story sits front and centre.

sections.label: Highlights
sections.body: Portfolio carousel showcasing landmark Jersey projects • Service architecture covering planning, environment, community and EIA work • Full-bleed island photography that roots the practice in place

title: BCR Law
subtitle: Legal services
summary: One site, three brands: a cinematic hub that lets visitors choose between BCR Pro, BCR Law and BCR EDA, each with its own identity and colourway.

sections.label: The brief
sections.body: BCR operates three distinct offerings: private client tax (Pro), the full-service law firm (Law) and executor and attorney support (EDA). The site had to give each brand room to breathe while keeping one coherent architecture and a shared backbone of people, articles and contact journeys.

sections.label: What we built
sections.body: A full-screen video triptych landing page splits the three brands, each carrying its own colour and typographic treatment through to dedicated sections. The Law site brings together a services carousel across eight practice areas, a Reading Room article library, team profiles and Legal 500 testimonials.

sections.label: Highlights
sections.body: Three-brand hub landing with full-screen video panels • Reading Room CMS for legal insight articles across practice areas • Legal 500 client testimonials and clear speak to an expert journeys

title: Allens Caravans
subtitle: Holiday and residential parks
summary: A warm, heritage-led site for a family holiday park business approaching its eightieth year, built around finding your own place to belong.

sections.label: The brief
sections.body: Allens Caravans has been creating park communities since 1947, with parks across the Midlands, Wales and Northamptonshire. The new site had to serve three distinct audiences at once: holiday home owners, residential park home buyers and short-break guests.

sections.label: What we built
sections.body: An elegant design led by the line 'Making memories for generations'. A home finder lets visitors search by location, new or pre-loved, and budget; a parks collection presents each location with holiday and residential tags; and clear journeys guide people to own, stay, book a tour or download the brochure.

sections.label: Highlights
sections.body: Home finder with location, condition and budget filters • Parks CMS with aerial photography for every location • Heritage-forward brand story with modern enquiry and booking journeys

title: Normans
subtitle: Builders' merchant and trade retail
summary: A no-nonsense trade brand online for Jersey's family-run builders' merchant, three generations old and still telling customers straight.

sections.label: The brief
sections.body: Normans has served Jersey's trade since 1923 across three branches. The site needed to work as hard as the yard does: helping builders find the right department, branch and account tools fast, on any device, often mid-job.

sections.label: What we built
sections.body: A bold, high-contrast design with a search-first header and quick actions for the things trade customers actually do: open a trade account in sixty seconds, pay an invoice, WhatsApp an order to a branch and hire tools. A branch finder pairs a live map with real-time opening status.

sections.label: Highlights
sections.body: Branch finder with live map and open now status for all three yards • Sixty-second trade account sign-up and pay an invoice journeys • WhatsApp ordering straight to the branch

title: Great Green Systems
subtitle: Ecommerce and environmental products
summary: A fresh, guidance-led Shopify store for the home of the Green Johanna and Green Cone, helping households and councils get ahead of new food waste regulations.

sections.label: The brief
sections.body: Composting is a considered purchase with lots of jargon. The store had to help shoppers choose the right system for their home and habits, serve both consumers and wholesale buyers, and capitalise on the new Simpler Recycling regulations.

sections.label: What we built
sections.body: A clean, optimistic storefront that organises products by aim and living space rather than category jargon, with best for guidance on every product family. Editorial sections explain the regulation changes, product carousels drive discovery, and a separate commercial store serves wholesalers and retailers.

sections.label: Highlights
sections.body: Shop by aim and by living space navigation that mirrors how people actually choose • Regulations explainer content tied to the Simpler Recycling changes • Consumer store and commercial wholesale store in one build

title: Team Monaco
subtitle: Sport and sustainability
summary: The official home of Monaco's electric raceboat team in the UIM E1 World Championship, blending race news, ocean advocacy and the 98 Collection merchandise store.

sections.label: The brief
sections.body: Team Monaco competes at the intersection of elite sport and ocean protection, with the backing of H.S.H. Prince Albert II. The site had to carry race news and team stories, champion the sustainability mission and sell merchandise, all under one brand.

sections.label: What we built
sections.body: A fast, editorial Shopify build that leads with race highlights and team storytelling, backed by the Protect Our Ocean sustainability platform and heritage stats reaching back to 1862. The 98 Collection brings team merchandise into the same home.

sections.label: Highlights
sections.body: Race news and video highlights alongside team and pilot profiles • Protect Our Ocean sustainability storytelling with the Prince Albert II Foundation quote • 98 Collection merchandise store integrated into the main site

title: ExecTA Social
subtitle: Professional community and membership
summary: A playful, space-themed home for the universe's only exclusive community for Heads of Talent Acquisition, now landing in cities across the globe.

sections.label: The brief
sections.body: ExecTA Social is a closed-door community for senior TA leaders, so the site had to feel exclusive and fun at the same time: credible enough for VPs at global brands, characterful enough to stand apart from every corporate community platform.

sections.label: What we built
sections.body: A distinctive identity built around a rocket-and-UFO space theme, animated typography and a bold magenta accent. Membership and partner journeys are kept crisp, a wall of member testimonials from companies like Sage, ThoughtWorks and Mimecast builds trust, and a live chapter list shows the community's global spread.

sections.label: Highlights
sections.body: Characterful space-themed brand world with animated type • Member testimonial wall featuring 1,200 plus global Heads of TA • Application-based membership and partner journeys with a global chapter map
